we have synthesized a new diruthenapenta- and diruthenatetra- borane clusters and have shown the reaction of a diruthenapen- taborane cluster with PMe3 to give a diruthenabutyliden- eborane cluster.

the synthesis, structural characterization, and reactivity of diruthenaborane clusters, [{CpRuCp*Ru(η4-B4H8)}] (1) and [{(CpRuC)2(μ-η5-C5H4)}(μ-H)(μ-η2-B2H5)(μ-η5-B4H7)] (3), and their reactions with various borane and phosphine reagents.
the synthesis and reactivity of boron hydride clusters.
the syntheses, structural characterizations, and reactivities of diruthenium clusters containing boron and phosphorus ligands, which have potential applications as catalysts.

the reaction of 1 with BH3·SMe2 or PMe3 leads only to the degradation of the cluster.
